svg.title: QUANTA: quantum annealing for species tree estimation
svg.desc: A dilution-refrigerator quantum computer sends signals through an annealing energy landscape into a bird species tree, whose taxa are shown as qubits. The tree is pruned to 14 birds from the avian tree QUANTA reports.
svg.text: quantum tunnelling toward the best bipartition of the taxa

g.text: Species tree estimation on a real quantum annealer
